findings.principle: 反射型 XSS：服务端把未编码的用户输入拼接进 HTML 响应，浏览器把该输入解析为标签与事件处理器并执行其中的 JavaScript。

poc.code: #!/usr/bin/env python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """XSS-002 reflected-XSS verification draft (harmless marker only). Authorized local teaching lab only. The draft: - accepts only http/https URLs whose host is localhost / 127.0.0.1 / ::1; - does not follow redirects automatically; - sends one GET request carrying an inert payload; - reports whether the payload is reflected unencoded (HTTP echo only). It never reads cookies from the target, never exfiltrates data and never stores content on the server. """ import argparse import sys import urllib.error import urllib.parse import urllib.request ALLOWED_HOSTS = {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"} DEFAULT_PAYLOAD = '' class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler): def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl): return None def build_target(base_url, param, payload): parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(base_url) if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https"): raise SystemExit("ABORT: only http/https URLs are allowed") host = parsed.hostname or "" if host not in ALLOWED_HOSTS: raise SystemExit("ABORT: host %r is not an authorized local target" % host) query = dict(urllib.parse.parse_qsl(parsed.query, keep_blank_values=True)) query[param] = payload return parsed._replace(query=urllib.parse.urlencode(query)).geturl() def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="XSS-002 harmless reflection check") parser.add_argument("--base-url", required=True, help="authorized local page, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080/vulnerabilities/xss_r/") parser.add_argument("--param", default="name") parser.add_argument("--payload", default=DEFAULT_PAYLOAD) parser.add_argument("--cookie-file", default=None, help="local file holding the Cookie header value (never committed)") parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=10.0) parser.add_argument("--raw-out", default=None, help="write the raw response body here") args = parser.parse_args() url = build_target(args.base_url, args.param, args.payload) request = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET") request.add_header("User-Agent", "llm-lab-xss002-audit-draft/1.0") if args.cookie_file: with open(args.cookie_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle: cookie = handle.read().strip() if cookie: request.add_header("Cookie", cookie) opener = urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect) try: with opener.open(request, timeout=args.timeout) as response: status = response.status body = response.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc: status = exc.code body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc: print("CONNECT_ERROR: %s" % exc, file=sys.stderr) return 2 if args.raw_out: with open(args.raw_out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: handle.write(body) print("HTTP_STATUS: %s" % status) reflected = args.payload in body encoded = "<img" in body print("PAYLOAD_REFLECTED_VERBATIM: %s" % reflected) print("HTML_ENCODED_MARKER_SEEN: %s" % encoded) if reflected: index = body.find(args.payload) window = body[max(0, index - 40): index + len(args.payload) + 40] print("REFLECTION_CONTEXT: %s" % window.replace(chr(10), " ")) print("NOTE: HTTP echo only; browser execution must be observed separately.") else: print("NOTE: no verbatim reflection; the value may be encoded or dropped.") return 0 if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())
